sections.title: Growth and habitat
sections.text: Pohlia melanodon is a small moss that forms scattered shoots or tufts about 1 cm tall. It grows on wet clay banks and other damp mineral soils.

sections.title: Leaves and capsules
sections.text: The upper leaves are about 1.5 mm long. Capsules may be horizontal or pendent and are borne on a reddish seta about 7–12 mm long.
